phases.exitBoundary: Contracts, live release inventory, routing/FY/URL state and requirement/action registries are frozen; the 721-file defense-budget mirror is byte-identical.

Tenant-scoped manual collections support create/edit/share/archive/restore, typed canonical or explicitly unresolved members, exclude/reinstate/resolve, client ethical-wall checks, immutable events, native list/detail routes and a navigation-only rollout flag.

Immutable taxonomy/template/rule lineage, constrained three-valued AST evaluation, canonical candidate materialization, explainable preview/publish, idempotent template versions, manual precedence, durable withdrawal history and bounded recompute receipts are implemented.

Program, PE, project and procurement dossiers expose explicit field gaps; milestones retain source-native precision; funding matrices separate edition/FY/stage/metric, distinguish zero from missing, resolve every emitted evidence ID, and retain execution amount-basis/metric/period fields.

Contextual documents have immutable revisions/sections and exact first-class occurrences; an official Federal Register rule family provides partial positive coverage and exact CFR occurrences, while hearings without qualified transcripts remain explicit unavailable cases with query-wide denominators.
